anomalies.message: CPU load average is significantly high across all intervals (1, 5, and 15 minutes), indicating potential overutilization or bottleneck.
AI system has not performed any recent learning cycles or generated opportunities, suggesting it may not be functioning correctly or is underutilized.
No active or closed trades, and all trading metrics are at zero, which might indicate a lack of trading activity or potential issues with strategy execution.

optimizations.recommendation: Investigate and optimize CPU usage by reviewing running processes or considering hardware upgrades to handle current load.
Review and potentially enhance AI learning algorithms to ensure they are actively generating opportunities and contributing to trading strategies.
Evaluate the effectiveness and configuration of active trading strategies to ensure they are being executed properly and contributing to trading activity.

recommendations.action: Conduct an immediate investigation into the high CPU load to identify and mitigate the cause to prevent potential system performance degradation.
recommendations.rationale: High CPU load can lead to system instability, slow down trading operations, and affect user experience, requiring urgent attention.

recommendations.action: Perform a diagnostic check on the AI system to ensure it is functioning correctly and actively contributing to trading strategies.
recommendations.rationale: AI inactivity can lead to missed trading opportunities and reduced platform effectiveness, necessitating prompt resolution.

recommendations.action: Review the configuration and execution of active trading strategies to ensure they are aligned with current market conditions and platform goals.
recommendations.rationale: Ensuring strategies are properly configured can improve trading activity and profitability.
